RestServiceDefinition.SqlExecute: SELECT accessPackagesCatalogs.displayName || '/' || accesspackages.displayName as RoleName, accesspackages.id, accessPackagesCatalogs.displayName as CatalogName, accesspackages.displayName || ' in Catalog ' || accessPackagesCatalogs.displayName || '(' || accesspackages.description || ')' as description, accesspackages.createdDateTime FROM accesspackages inner join accessPackagesCatalogs on accesspackages.catalog_id = accessPackagesCatalogs.id ;
